eligible_findings.claim: The Ollama manifest lookup uses library/qwen2.5:14b/latest.
eligible_findings.implication: A reader who has downloaded qwen2.5:14b cannot find its manifest with this command; the model-switching procedure stops before locating the blob.

primary_sources.evidence: The parser separates the colon tag from the model name; Filepath joins host, namespace, model and tag. qwen2.5:14b therefore maps to registry.ollama.ai/library/qwen2.5/14b.

eligible_findings.smallest_supported_correction: Replace only the manifest path with ~/.ollama/models/manifests/registry.ollama.ai/library/qwen2.5/14b; preserve the example model name and remaining command.

eligible_findings.claim: The incident presents the displayed architecture-aware fallback as a fix for Qwen2 or Llama 3; missing RoPE metadata selects 10000 for non-Qwen architectures.
eligible_findings.implication: For a Llama 3 checkpoint missing this key, the displayed fallback can remove the exception while using the wrong rotary-position configuration. This is a silent inference-correctness risk, not a successful general model-loading fix.

primary_sources.evidence: The Llama 3 reference defaults rope_theta to 500000 and passes that value to precompute_freqs_cis.
The downloadable recorded patch contains the same fallback; the problem is the general applicability implied by its explanation.

eligible_findings.smallest_supported_correction: Preserve the historical code and add an immediate checkpoint-specific limit: this workaround is for the recorded checkpoint; it must not be applied unchanged to Llama 3, whose reference RoPE base is 500000. Recover missing RoPE and tokenizer metadata from the specific checkpoint configuration or reject the checkpoint. Do not imply a problem when the GGUF key is present.
